subject: Limits Reference — every hardcoded SA limit with its VA, value, and safe modification guidance
discovery_note: All values proven cold from the exe by Capstone disassembly. No external project data used as numerical evidence. Community tool cross-references (SA Limit Adjuster) noted where relevant but never used as the primary source.

entity_pool_limits.name: Max Peds (CPed pool slots)
entity_pool_limits.safe_increase: Up to ~250 tested by community. Beyond 400 risks OOM crash. Each CPed slot = 1988 bytes; 140→200 = ~120KB extra.
entity_pool_limits.what_breaks: OOM crash from m_pObjects malloc failure. Ped task system (CTaskManager, C44) loops over pool — very large counts slow AI update.

entity_pool_limits.name: Max Vehicles (CVehicle pool slots)
entity_pool_limits.safe_increase: Up to ~170 stable. Each slot = 2584 bytes; 110→150 = ~103KB extra.
entity_pool_limits.what_breaks: OOM at very high counts. CCarCtrl spawn logic may exceed separate vehicle density cap (0xA9A894 compared against 100 at 0x49BA6B).

entity_pool_limits.name: Max Buildings (CBuilding pool slots)
entity_pool_limits.safe_increase: Community increases to 20000+ for modded maps with dense static geometry. Each slot = 56 bytes; 13000→20000 = ~392KB extra.
entity_pool_limits.what_breaks: Exceeding the pool before the IPL finishes loading causes entities to fail placement (silently dropped, not crash).

entity_pool_limits.name: Max Dynamic Objects (CObject pool slots)
entity_pool_limits.safe_increase: Up to 1000 without issues. Each slot = 412 bytes; 350→600 = ~103KB extra.
entity_pool_limits.what_breaks: Script-created objects (CREATE_OBJECT opcode) silently fail to create when pool is full. Object physics loop (C25) slows proportionally.

entity_pool_limits.name: Max Active Explosions (CActiveExplosion pool slots)
entity_pool_limits.note: Fixed-size static array, not a heap-allocated pool. Changing requires patching the array size constant used in the range check at 0x73702C.

density_limits.name: CCarCtrl vehicle density accumulator cap
density_limits.note: Compared as cmp ecx, 0x12C (300). This is an internal density accumulator, not a direct slot count. The value at 0xA9A894 is incremented and compared — when it exceeds 300, the traffic spawner backs off. Safe to increase; lowering it reduces traffic density.

density_limits.name: Ped density cap A
density_limits.note: CPopulation density gate. Controls max simultaneous ped count at medium density setting.

density_limits.name: Ped density cap B
density_limits.note: Second CPopulation density comparison. Related to indoor/zone-capped ped spawning.

density_limits.name: Ped density cap C
density_limits.note: Used at two sites (0x575227 and 0x582F0C). Candidate: max peds-on-foot near player. Value 80 is hardcoded.

timer_limits.name: ms_fTimeStep maximum (physics stall cap)
timer_limits.note: If one frame takes >100ms, physics advance is capped to 2.0 ticks (100ms). Prevents tunnelling through geometry on loading hitches. Safe to increase slightly (3.0) to handle slower machines; decreasing causes physics to slow down on fast machines.

streaming_limits.note: Streaming buffer sizes proven at 0x4C7066 (push 0x2000=8KB), 0x4C70C9 (push 0x8000=32KB). These are intermediate streaming read buffers, not total memory budget. The streaming memory budget is set at runtime via CStreaming::ms_memoryAvailable and is not a hardcoded limit in the same sense.

patch_strategy.tool_reference: SA Limit Adjuster (community tool) patches the push-imm arguments in CPools::Initialise before they execute. The same effect can be achieved with a code cave that overwrites the pool slot counts before CGame::Initialise calls CPools::Initialise.
safe_order: 1. Calculate memory cost: new_count * stride_bytes for each pool you increase
2. Verify total stays under 500MB (leave headroom for the game's other allocations)
3. Patch the push-imm at the evidence_va for each pool
4. Never decrease slot counts below original — scripts may depend on handle ranges
